nodes.label: Living Fairy Faith
nodes.evidence_status: Terminology, ringfort dates, folklore motifs, festival associations, and storyteller role are fact-checked with explicit corrections.
nodes.rationale: The sídhe, Otherworld, fairy forts, changelings, banshees, púca, pisheogs, liminal places, and seasonal festivals formed a lived cosmology coexisting with Catholicism.

nodes.label: Supernatural Ambiguity Principle
nodes.rationale: The game should neither confirm nor deny supernatural causation, preserving the worldview in which rational and uncanny interpretations remain intertwined.
